newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ building consents rose in yr to March - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ building consents rose in yr to March - SNZ.

text.p: New Zealand non-residential building consents rose in value by 6.5 percent in the year to March to NZ$2.34 billion, Statistics NZ (SNZ) said on Friday.

But SNZ said that on a monthly basis non-residential consents fell for the third month in a row. Consents worth NZ$121.7 million were issued for non-residential buldings in March, down from NZ$145.0 million in February.
Consents for residential buildings had been stable in recent months and rose 6.1 percent to NZ$3.56 billion in the March year.
SNZ said the annual increase in non-residential consents was due to large project consents from 1996 rather than the results for 1997. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
